zh: 线下场景：零售空间与终端物料系统
en: Offline Scenarios: Retail Space & Terminal Material System

zh: 将品牌系统延展到零售空间与终端物料，沉淀可复制铺设的线下执行标准。
en: Extending the brand system to retail spaces and terminal materials, establishing replicable offline execution standards.

zh: 将品牌系统延展到零售空间与终端物料，沉淀可复制铺设的线下执行标准。
en: Extending the brand system to retail spaces and terminal materials, establishing replicable offline execution standards.

zh: KIYOMI 主视觉
en: KIYOMI Key Visual

zh: 用「系列海报版式系统」将主视觉、口号、产品与场景「模块化统一」，快速产出可铺满「线下触点」的高识别宣传物料。
en: Using a「poster layout system」to modularize key visuals, slogans, products, and scenes, enabling rapid production of high-recognition promotional materials for「offline touchpoints」.

zh: 尼古丁糖主视觉
en: Nicotine Drops Key Visual

zh: 用「区域版本海报」+「场景用途分层」+「口味卡矩阵」的视觉套件，批量匹配「全球区域」与「渠道终端」的宣传需求。
en: Using「regional posters」+「scene layering」+「flavor card matrix」visual kits to batch-match promotional needs across「global regions」and「channel terminals」.

zh: 混合产品主视觉
en: Mixed Products Key Visual

zh: M1·R15·烟油 主视觉
en: M1·R15·E-Liquid Key Visual

zh: CUBE 产品实拍
en: CUBE Product Photography

zh: 用「配色体系落地」+「工厂跟产」+「实拍验证」+「配件适配」的模块化交付，把设计从屏幕带到真实零售场景，为后续营销活动沉淀可直接使用的内容资产。
en: Through modular delivery of「color system implementation」+「factory follow-up」+「photography validation」+「accessory adaptation」, bringing design from screen to real retail scenarios, accumulating directly usable content assets for subsequent marketing activities.

zh: MOTOR 产品实拍
en: MOTOR Product Photography

zh: 用「硅胶套保护配件」+「挂绳场景」的模块化周边设计，把便携与防护价值做成可搭售、可传播的营销资产，支持终端陈列与活动赠品体系。
en: Through modular accessory design of「silicone case protection」+「lanyard scenarios」, transforming portability and protection value into cross-sellable and shareable marketing assets, supporting terminal display and promotional gift systems.

zh: 展架实拍
en: Display Stand Photography

zh: 用「展示柜/货架陈列」+「终端卖点包装」+「跳跳卡装饰」的模块化零售物料，把不同产品的售卖信息系统化落地到终端，提升陈列吸引力与转化效率。
en: Through modular retail materials of「display cabinet/shelf display」+「terminal selling point packaging」+「wobbler decoration」, systematically implementing sales information for different products at terminals, enhancing display attractiveness and conversion.

zh: 店面实拍
en: Store Photography

zh: 用「跨国家门店实景验证」的模块化复盘，把物料在不同终端与陈列环境中的真实落地效果可视化呈现，帮助团队快速迭代并支持渠道复制铺设。
en: Through modular review of「cross-country store real-scene validation」, visualizing the actual implementation of materials in different terminals and display environments, helping teams iterate quickly and supporting channel replication.

zh: 包装实拍
en: Packaging Photography

zh: 用「包装系统打样」+「实拍校验」的模块化流程，把配色、工艺、信息层级与陈列效果在量产前一次性对齐，为渠道上架与营销投放提供可靠的成品资产。
en: Through modular process of「packaging system sampling」+「photography validation」, aligning color, craftsmanship, information hierarchy, and display effects before mass production, providing reliable finished assets for channel listing and marketing.

zh: 展会实拍
en: Exhibition Photography

zh: 用「展会空间视觉」+「互动装置」+「物料系统」的模块化落地，把品牌体验在海外展会现场快速搭建并统一呈现，支持获客、引导与渠道洽谈。
en: Through modular implementation of「exhibition space visuals」+「interactive installations」+「material systems」, rapidly building and uniformly presenting brand experiences at overseas exhibitions, supporting customer acquisition, guidance, and channel negotiations.

zh: 效果图展示
en: Mockups Showcase

zh: 用「活动场景渲染」+「物料套件复用」的模块化效果图体系，把促销、展陈、渠道沟通所需的视觉快速落地，提升方案呈现质量与复用效率。
en: Through modular mockup system of「event scene rendering」+「material kit reuse」, rapidly implementing visuals needed for promotions, displays, and channel communication, improving presentation quality and reuse efficiency.

zh: 零售空间的成功落地标志着品牌系统的成熟
en: Successful retail implementation marks brand system maturity

zh: 系统在多维度场景中得到验证，为品牌的持续发展奠定基础。
en: The system is validated across multi-dimensional scenarios, laying the foundation for continuous brand development.
